dct_title_s: U.S. Marine Protected Area Boundaries : MPA Inventory
dct_description_sm: These data represent the boundaries of Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) in North America. MPAs are areas of the oceans or Great Lakes that are protected for a conservation purpose. Managed by the federal government, the national system of MPAs brings work together at the regional and national levels to achieve common objectives for conserving the nation's important natural and cultural resources.
System requirements: Geographic Information Systems (GIS) software that reads ESRI shapefile format.
